text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Monday arrives for a two-day visit to Bratislava. Chernomyrdin is expected to sign 13 agreements with Slovakia ranging from Russian-Slovak joint ventures to technical military cooperation.
- Commercial bank Istrobanka has issued an unspecified tranche of one-year depository certificates carrying a fixed interest rate of 12.5 percent.

- The opposition Party of the Democratic Left (SDL) recommends a vote in favour of NATO membership in the forthcoming referendum on integration to the alliance. But SDL said people should vote against deployment of nuclear weapons in Slovakia.
- The average unemployment rate in Slovakia was 12.6 percent in 1996.
- The Bratislava Stock Exchange posted a 1996 after-tax profit of 30 million crowns on a turnover of 113 billion crowns.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Banka Slovakia plans to issue a 400 million crown tranche of four year domestic bonds by the end of June.
- Slovakia's unemployment rate dropped to 13.44 percent in March, down 0.25 percentage points from February.
- The Czech-Slovak custom union is not expected to be cancelled in the near future even after the controversy over measures both countries implemented in recent weeks to fight foreign trade problems.
- The National Bank of Slovakia might consider easing its monetary policy if funds collected from import deposits are held on its account and drain liquidity from the market.
- Slovakia's largest insurer Slovenska Poistovna a.s. has called an annual shareholder meeting on May 28.
SME - Russian ambassador to Slovakia Sergei Zotov said Moscow could guarantee Slovakia's military neutrality if Bratislava officially ask Russia to do so.

- Chairman of the Constitutional Court Milan Cic said the government's request to consider whether a planned referendum on direct presidential elections was in line with the consitution will have no direct impact on organisation of the plebiscite.
PRAVDA - A prepared amendment to the criminal code will not include the introduction of a death penalty.
